name: Learned shot spotter on the panorama, tested on M5 (owner decision 2026-10-21)
registered: 2026-10-21, before any training clip is cut or processed and before any M5 detection exists
known peeks (disclosed): M5's BAS SHOT/GOAL frames were read to plan its clips and draw their order (29 merged clips, 33 attempts). No M5 video, detection or other label was read.
The rule of protocol_shots.json failed on dev (1/32, frozen_shots.json); its diagnostic (shots_dev_diagnostic.json) is known.
backend: Kaggle T4 x2, fp32, as research/session_scratchpad/kaggle/backend_note.json + addendum1 + addendum2 (players step with --calibrated, ball over the span +-2 s of a clip only; both shown output-identical, compare_opt.json). Training and test on this backend.

units.clip: -15 s / +10 s around each BAS SHOT and GOAL of a half, merged where they overlap (kaggle/cut_shot_clips.py spans); cut with 400 frames each side; players on the whole cut, the ball on [span start - 50, span end + 50] local frames; features and labels only inside the span
units.training units: the clips of all their SHOT/GOAL (194 clips) plus the 7 processed GPU windows of these matches (whole windows, extra negatives)
units.excluded: M7 and M9 (sealed, spent on the rule's dev); M5 until the test
units.test: M5 (118577): its 29 clips (33 attempts), in the registered order below

ball and players input: per unit, as shots_dev.py metric_of: v3 rows, painted marks dropped, static points dropped, linked (v3s_link), to pitch metres with the release calibration

model.features: learn.py's per-frame features (ball, candidates, nearest players, changes across t; FEATURE_VERSION 1) plus goal geometry at t and over +-12 frames: distance from the point to the nearer goal centre, the point's velocity component towards that goal, and whether the velocity ray meets that goal line within 5 m of the mouth
model.classifier: learn.py's HistGradientBoostingClassifier settings, one class 'shot' (SHOT or GOAL label within 0.24 s of t)
model.events: peaks of the smoothed probability above a threshold, at least 1.0 s apart
model.threshold: by rate on the training data's out-of-fold predictions (events closest in number to the labels), as learn.py

dev.validation: nested leave-one-match-out over the 7 training matches, thresholds by rate on the inner folds (learn.py nested)
dev.measures: recall at 2 s (one to one, SHOT and GOAL), precision, events, per match
dev.go to the test only if: pooled cross-validated recall >= 0.45 AND precision >= 0.40; otherwise stop, report, no M5 processing
dev.then: one final model on all 7 matches, rate thresholds; frozen in frozen.json with its sha256 before any M5 clip is cut

test.order: M5 clips processed in the order drawn with numpy default_rng(20261021).permutation(29) over the clips listed half 1 then half 2, by time: [0, 7, 12, 15, 6, 21, 27, 19, 3, 24, 22, 9, 23, 11, 17, 20, 16, 1, 14, 13, 10, 8, 5, 26, 18, 2, 28, 25, 4]
test.primary: recall at 2 s, one to one, on the 33 M5 attempts, with a Wilson 95% interval
secondary: the frozen rule of frozen_shots.json on the same spans
test.success: recall >= 18/33 AND precision >= 0.50 on the M5 spans
test.early stop (owner decision 2026-10-21): after each batch is scored: stop when success is out of reach, i.e. hits so far + attempts not yet processed < 18, or false shots so far > hits so far + attempts not yet processed (precision could no longer reach 0.50). The result is then 'fails (stopped after k of 29 clips)' with the counts so far. No stop for success: the test runs to the end when it can still succeed.
